scope: The initial GNS Hilbert space is the closure of the concrete dual orbit on the uniformly finite ideal. Its norm square is the original scalar dual weight; the Haar factor is retained explicitly.
The generic Context assumes faithfulness of the original weight, and CanonicalFockGNS supplies it from the concrete prior theorem; GNS conclusions are not premises.

The representation is the restriction of the existing dual-orbit representation to a reducing subspace. Injectivity on the initial ideal follows from the weight. Faithfulness of the whole representation and equality with the full n_nu completion are not yet asserted by this receipt.

Gaussian multiplication defines a continuous injective map into the existing ambient L2, not an isomorphism or a change of the scalar weight. Strictly positive Gaussian and faithful original weight make the auxiliary vector separating.

Both coordinates of the initial adjunction graph are transported by this continuous injective map. Closability of the auxiliary vector graph forces a zero vertical fibre in the original graph closure. No analytic modular identification is smuggled into this argument.

This is source-semantic review of the six listed critical sources, plus 65 pin checks and the constructor build receipts. It is not an independent rebuild or a complete review of every source in the 13-component batch.
Scaled trace, its modular identification, full-domain/density consumers and complete Takesaki bridge remain distinct work.
